use_when: A pull request, feature or repository needs a security read before shipping — especially anything touching auth, money, tenancy, uploads, deserialization or secrets — or someone reports reaching data they should not have.
not_for: Design-stage boundary and asset work (threat-modeling), the class-by-class pattern hunt itself (owasp-web), running scanners as a substitute for reading, or any form of live testing, which is separately authorized.
